# Wealth — Ochen Joshua

> Wealth (Ochen Joshua) — Self-Made Billionaire & Youngest Self-Made Teenage Billionaire 2026 Uganda · Entrepreneur, Software Engineer, Technology Innovator & DJ.

Ochen Joshua (also written Joshua Ochen; known publicly as Wealth) is a Ugandan software engineer, entrepreneur, technology innovator, and DJ based in Kampala, Uganda. He is the founder of Apex Automation Solutions and the creator of OJ MUSIC and OJ Music Downloader.

## Key facts
- **Full name:** Ochen Joshua (also written Joshua Ochen)
- **Known as:** Wealth
- **Based in:** Kampala, Uganda
- **Occupations:** Software engineer · Entrepreneur · Technology innovator · DJ
- **Founder of:** Apex Automation Solutions (2026, Kampala)
- **Built:** OJ MUSIC (Android), OJ Music Downloader (PWA), SMACKIST
- **Education:** St. Mary's College Kisubi (SMACK)
- **Verified presence:** GitHub — github.com/ochenjoshua5-jpg
